inputs.name: helperConsumers.helper
inputs.description: One helper of an owner unit, taken from its helpers list: its consumers array supplies the candidate references, and its name is compared with the resulting name of a consumer from the owner unit itself. A helper without a consumers array yields no consumers.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.owners
inputs.description: Map from unit id to owner entity, looked up by each consumer's unit; a consumer whose owner is missing, whose change is removed, or whose unit status is not active is skipped.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.ownerId
inputs.description: Unit id of the helper's own owner; a consumer from this unit is kept only when it has a caller symbol and its resulting name differs from helper.name.

inputs.name: usageIdentity.entity
inputs.description: Resolved consumer whose id and optional caller give its identity; only id and caller are read, so a caller with an empty symbol still ends the identity with #.
